question: Should ClawHub own runtime promotions as a core platform surface now, including permanent promotion records, public/admin APIs, hosted feed publication, homepage placement, admin CLI commands, and a production deploy publish step?
rationale: This is a new product and release workflow rather than a bug fix; automation can review implementation shape but cannot decide long-term platform ownership, launch timing, or deploy fail-closed policy.

options.title: Proceed After Deploy Proof
options.body: Accept the core promotions surface, verify the new production snapshot-publish path, then undraft and merge under maintainer release timing.

options.title: Keep Draft Until Consumer Lands
options.body: Leave the PR open as the producer branch until the OpenClaw promos consumer is accepted enough to coordinate copy and release sequencing.

options.title: Decline Or Split Surface
options.body: Ask for a narrower producer-only or feed-contract proposal if maintainers do not want homepage, admin, CLI, and deploy promotions in ClawHub core yet.

recommendation.title: Proceed After Deploy Proof
recommendation.body: Accept the core promotions surface, verify the new production snapshot-publish path, then undraft and merge under maintainer release timing.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the live promotions branch and have adjacent current-main catalog history, making them the best first owner for the product and release decision packet.
